articles.title: Dallas’ Southwest Airlines Launches ChatGPT Plugin to Help Customers Find Flights
articles.summary: Dallas-based Southwest Airlines said it just became the first U.S. airline to incorporate flight-shopping capabilities directly into ChatGPT, one of the world’s most popular AI tools. Southwest’s ChatGPT plugin, which went live Tuesday, lets users search destinations and compare dates, times and fares in a ChatGPT conversation.…

articles.title: DFW Airport Creates New Role to Lead AI Push
articles.summary: Dallas Fort Worth International Airport is looking for a tech wizard to pilot its AI program — a significant hire in the airport’s quest to further embrace AI. A job posting on DFW Airport’s website said the full-time principal AI lead, a newly created job, will be the airport-wide “strategic and technical authority” on this quickly evolving technology. …

articles.title: Patented: Citi’s AI-Generated Suspicious Activity Reports and 105 More Inventions Across North Texas
articles.summary: A largely Irving-based team has patented a system that uses AI to help New York-based banking giant Citibank fight financial crime. The company, which has a large corporate office in Las Colinas, received a utility patent for systems and methods to draft suspicious activity reports using large language models.…

articles.title: Patented: Lennox’s Machine-Learning Thermostat Scheduling and 105 More Inventions Across North Texas
articles.summary: Richardson-based Lennox Industries, a subsidiary of Lennox International (NYSE: LII), has patented a heating, ventilation and air conditioning control device. The patent application describes a device that uses machine learning to predict when a building is occupied and adjust its schedule based on how aggressively the user wants to save energy.…

articles.title: Despite tough talk from Abbott and Paxton, Texas penalties for data center violations are light
articles.summary: Texas officials are promising tougher enforcement on data centers, but the existing law may offer limited leverage over the industry that has largely failed to report its water use.

articles.summary: El Paso and New Mexico planned to cut greenhouse gas emissions. Neither plan considered how three new data centers could upend their climate goals.

articles.title: 'A long game': When is the best time to initiate a data center moratorium in Texas?
articles.summary: Last month, Lubbock City Council began the procedure to adopt a pause on large-scale data center development. If the moratorium passes, it will be two years until another one can be put in place. With more information and potential changes likely to come out of the state's legislative session, one councilman has argued that the city should hold off on playing its moratorium card. All the while, the clock may be ticking on the statewide pause on data centers.
